name: voyager-v1
description: The two decision calls a Voyager episode makes, asked over states built the way crates/voyager builds them. `skill` items give a goal and a candidate set of banked skills — the retrieval that decides whether a task reuses code or writes new. `verdict` items give a goal with before/after agent states — the critic's noul check where no mechanical spec applies. Each item pins the meadow world digest and the task id in its state so a row is attributable to a declared task. The paper's ablations map to suite variants by name: no-curriculum runs a fixed list (the suite arm), no-skill-library never retrieves (none), no-critic accepts ran-only, and manual-curriculum is this suite's declared arm; a variant suite gets its own id and digest rather than an item flag.
